title: Sparse matrix results of symbolic user functions with the pattern fixed when they are recorded
author: Claude-JG
description: Mass matrices and Jacobians of ObjectGenericODE2 and ObjectUserBody can be very sparse. A symbolic result esym.SparseMatrix - triplets (row, column, expression) - or an esym.Matrix built from components, whose components that are the constant 0 are known when it is recorded, evaluates into the triplets of the item's MatrixContainer in sparse mode; CopyOrAddTriplets adds them to the system matrix as for a Python function that returns triplets or a scipy matrix. Revision2026c step RG12.3.7.4.
releaseNotes: A matrix result of a symbolic user function built from components is sparse: its components that are the constant 0 are left out when the function is recorded, and the others are added to the system matrix as triplets; a chain of 300 masses with a diagonal mass matrix and a tridiagonal Jacobian solves in 0.26 s against 3.6 s with Python functions building the dense lists.
